items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Meetin' Snaggett. Let's hear Snaggett. ... [INTERVIEWEE] We'll play snaggett.

ctx.x: That's right. And work on down the strings until he could get a good attack. Get a good attack. And he could get the sound and hear from him. Yeah. Let him play his commandics like that. And maybe play back and forth. You develop a good wrist. You know, play from one to five down. Yeah, with flexible race. That's right.

Are there any of these tunes you'd like to hear that you bring with Oren? Mahogany Hall, Sugar Blues, Georgia Kent, Meetin' Snaggett? Let's hear Snaggett. I didn't hear that. We'll play that jazz band ball.

That's what I want to hear. That's what I want to hear. We'll play jazz band ball. We'll play snaggett. We'll play snaggett. Never heard nobody play like Eddie Continental. Eddie move in 59th Street. Oh, he is.
